next.reason: 1985: 'Parentheses may appear only in balanced pairs of left and right parentheses delimiting subscripts, reference modifiers, arithmetic expressions, or conditions.'; 2023: 'Except in pseudo-text, ... a list of function or method arguments, a reference modifier, arithmetic or boolean expressions, or conditions.'. Same subject, but 2023 permits more uses: function and method argument lists, boolean expressions, and unbalanced parentheses in pseudo-text. The permitted cases are wider than in 1985.
